title: Create: Steam & Stone
description: Create: Steam & Stone is a steampunk-inspired Minecraft modpack focused on mechanical automation, industrial progression, and immersive worldbuilding powered by the Create mod.
body:
Mods Included

Create – Build intricate mechanical systems powered by rotational force, from simple windmills to sprawling steam-driven factories filled with gears, belts, and moving contraptions.

Applied Energistics 2 – Master advanced digital storage and automation with powerful networks, smart crafting, and centralized item management for large-scale engineering.

Chipped – Unlock hundreds of decorative block variations to give your medieval towns, industrial districts, and factories rich visual detail.

Sophisticated Backpacks – Carry customizable, upgradeable backpacks with modular storage and utility upgrades perfect for builders, engineers, and explorers.

Create Addons – Expand your mechanical toolkit with additional machines, compatibility features, and enhanced engineering options.

Immersive Aircraft – Take to the skies with craftable early-technology aircraft that fit perfectly into a steampunk-industrial progression.

Framed Blocks – Build with customizable framed blocks that can mimic other materials, giving you near-limitless design flexibility.

Farmer’s Delight – Expand farming and cooking with new crops, meals, and rustic food mechanics that enhance survival and worldbuilding.

Simple Voice Chat – Communicate with nearby players using immersive proximity voice chat for a more dynamic multiplayer experience.
